# owned by

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ownedBy`](gmeow-ownedBy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ownedBy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates something to an agent that owns it. Inverse of [`gmeow:ownerOf`](gmeow-ownerOf.md). Non-functional — an entity may have several owners.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when traversing or projecting from an owned entity to its owners — the asset-rooted direction.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting [`gmeow:ownedBy`](gmeow-ownedBy.md) directly when the owner's perspective is natural — assert [`gmeow:ownerOf`](gmeow-ownerOf.md) and read this as its inverse — and avoid it where share or period matter (use an ownership relator).

### How to use

- Prefer asserting [`gmeow:ownerOf`](gmeow-ownerOf.md) and let [`gmeow:ownedBy`](gmeow-ownedBy.md) follow by inversion; reach for it explicitly only in asset-rooted projections.
